protocol.integrator: AGAMA orbit, adaptive DOP853, accuracy=1e-9, unsoftened frozen TOTAL converged potential; not a self-gravitating KDK run
protocol.qualification: Tests action-DF stationarity in its own continuum field; excludes live self-response and granularity of all components. Cannot substitute for free N-body tests.

conservation.algorithm: AGAMA frozen total continuum potential; orbital energy, not N-body self energy

conventions.cylindricalAxis: R=0 particles omitted from cylindrical velocity moments only

plane.method: 6-step Huber IRLS PCA, 2.5 MAD-normal scales; geometric median center; spherical fit aperture; signed-height median intercept

conventions.normalVelocity: projected velocity minus population mean; no rotating-frame rate subtraction
conventions.rings: instantaneous cylindrical selections in fitted global plane; not tracked cohorts
conventions.warp: local median height and local normal versus fitted global plane
conventions.oddModes: antipodal initialization suppresses odd modes; pair correlations retained in null reference
conventions.basis: global x projected into fitted plane; possible geometric phase evolution under changing tilt

cohorts.qualification: fixed initial cylindrical labels; complements instantaneous rings, no particle remapping
